system.description: This power allows you to render a portion of another vampire's blood inert and unusable. By succeeding in a Mental Challenge, you spend a Mental Trait for every Blood Trait you wish to block. The target may only use those "blocked" Blood Traits after spending an equal number of Willpower Traits; this may be done one Trait at a time until complete, but none of the blocked vitae is usable until it is all freed.
system.duration: Until Willpower is spent to unblock
